value.rationale: An arbitrary marked chord pattern has exponentially many possible shapes, yet its effect on the natural descent observable collapses to one local statistic. Exact opposite-sign/zero correlations with crossing, nesting and alignment counts explain a meaningful distinction between chord topology and permutation-order dependence; the finding is neither an arbitrary slice nor merely a finite enumeration.
